1049.description: Support yourself on a bench and kick one leg back and up. It works the glutes without any equipment.
instructions: Place your hands on a bench and step back into a hinged position.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Lower without letting your hips rotate.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1113.description: A strap row to the face with elbows high that targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold the handles with palms facing in and lean back.
Keep your body straight and arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your forehead, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
Do not let your hips drop.

1177.description: A bench press with dumbbells held in a neutral grip that is easier on the shoulders.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Start with the weights above your chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

1241.description: From hands and knees, you extend opposite arm and leg. It builds core control and back stability.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg back.
Keep your hips level and your back flat.
Hold for a moment, then return.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.

1305.description: Push a medicine ball away from your chest in one strong effort, reset, then go again. It trains explosive power in the chest and arms.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the medicine ball at chest level.
Extend your arms forward, pushing the medicine ball away from your chest.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the medicine ball back to your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将健身球保持在胸部水平。
向前伸展双臂，将药球推离胸部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将健身球放回胸前。
重复所需的重复次数。

1369.description: A standing calf raise with a resistance band under both feet. It builds the calves and ankle strength with progressive tension.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a resistance band under both feet.
Hold the ends of the band with your hands for stability.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并将阻力带放在双脚下方。
用手握住带子的末端以保持稳定。
用小腿将脚跟抬离地面，尽可能高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1433.description: A front squat on a smith machine with a clean grip. The bar path is guided so you can focus on the quads and glutes.
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
Stand facing the barbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back and position the barbell on your front shoulders, resting it on your collarbone and deltoids.
Keep your chest up, back straight, and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃置于肩高的史密斯机上。
面向杠铃站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
后退一步，将杠铃放在前肩上，放在锁骨和三角肌上。
保持挺胸、背部挺直、核心收紧。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或略低于地面。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1497.description: A bench press with bands that lighten the load at the bottom and add heavier tension near the top. It builds pressing strength.
instructions: Set up on a bench with bands anchored to the rack and attached to the bar.
Lie back with your eyes under the bar and your shoulder blades pinched.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press the bar back up to straight arms, feeling the band resistance change.
Keep your feet planted and your wrists stacked over your elbows.

1561.description: A gentle quad stretch using a stability ball for support. It opens up the front of the thigh.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a stability ball with your torso upright.
Hold on to something steady for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glutes, holding your ankle.
Keep your knees close together and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1625.description: A close grip bench press on a decline bench in the smith machine. It builds the triceps and lower chest.
instructions: Adjust the bench on the smith machine to a decline position.
Lie down on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell is just above your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机上的长凳调整至下降位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚牢牢踩在地上。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其缓慢降低至胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃位于胸部正上方时，暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1689.description: A bodyweight movement of pushing and pulling against your own resistance. It trains the chest and arms.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body straight.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
From the push-up position, pull your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body straight.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体伸直。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
从俯卧撑位置开始，弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向地面，保持身体伸直。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1753.description: A bench dip with hands on the bench edge and body hanging off the front. A classic bodyweight move for the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部并降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1817.description: Resting your arms on a support and sinking down stretches the biceps and front of the shoulders. The support does part of the work for you.
instructions: Place your hands or forearms on a bench or other stable support behind you.
Lower your body slightly and lean away until you feel a stretch in the front of your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1881.description: Tuck one leg under the other in standing to stretch the outer hip.
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Pass one leg behind and under the other.
Push your hips gently to the side of the back leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

2137.description: A seated dumbbell press that rotates the palms from facing you to facing forward as you lift. Hits all three heads of the shoulder.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing your body and elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended and your palms are facing forward.
Rotate your wrists as you lift, so that your palms are facing forward at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在有背部支撑的长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝向身体，肘部弯曲。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展，手掌朝前。
抬起时旋转手腕，使手掌在动作的最高点朝前。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2265.description: A plate-loaded seated row that trains the upper back and lats through a guided pulling path.
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then sit with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your torso by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight again.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2329.description: A seated torso rotation, twisting side to side. Loosens the spine and works the obliques.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the left side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将双脚平放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向右扭转躯干，将右肘拉向左膝盖。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
向左侧重复扭转，将左肘拉向右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

2393.description: A one-arm row in a bent-over position that works the back and arm.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, one hand on a bench or knee for support.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your arm hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your elbow close.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

2713.description: An overhead press using a heavy iron block, building shoulder and arm strength.
instructions: Lift the block to your shoulders and set your feet hip width apart.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the block overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause at the top.
Lower it back to your shoulders under control.

2777.description: Moving the arm back behind the body, working the lats and rear shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm straight down at your side.
Swing the arm back behind you, keeping it straight.
Avoid leaning forward, pause, then return to the start.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2841.description: A Pilates move where the legs trace circles overhead, training the obliques and lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs raised up.
Lift your hips slightly and swing your legs across to one side.
Circle them down and around.
Bring them back up to the start.
Reverse the direction.

2905.description: A rear fly done with a power sled for resistance. Works the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold the sled handles with arms out in front and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly.

2969.description: A squat into overhead press with dumbbells that works the legs and shoulders in one flow.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

3161.description: A standing one arm row using a towel as the handle, pulled toward the chest. It trains the upper back with very little equipment.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a towel with one hand.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the towel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

3225.description: Lying face down, you lift your arms out to the sides into a T. It strengthens the mid and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor.
Turn your thumbs up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3289.description: An advanced dip on parallel bars with the legs crossed or lifted. It trains the triceps and chest through a tough range.
instructions: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体悬浮在空中。
弯曲膝盖并交叉脚踝。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3353.description: A single arm overhead extension on a high pulley that stretches and loads the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Face away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with one hand.
Stand in a split stance with your elbow pointing up.
Extend your arm forward and up until it is straight.
Keep your upper arm still.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

3417.description: A kneeling drill where one arm reaches, rolls and lifts to open the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Reach one arm forward along the floor.
Roll that arm up and across, rotating your chest.
Lift it toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Return and repeat, then switch arms.

3481.description: A low lunge hold in a sprinter stance for the legs and hips.
instructions: Step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Hold the low position briefly.
Push up.
Switch legs.

3545.description: A dumbbell press on an incline bench, with the arms alternating. It trains the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lean back on the bench and use your thighs to help raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Once at shoulder height, rotate your wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward.
Push the dumbbells up with your chest and shoulders, extending your arms fully.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
向后靠在长凳上，用大腿帮助将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
到达肩膀高度后，旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
用胸部和肩膀将哑铃向上推，充分伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回起始位置，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
重复所需的重复次数，交替手臂。

3673.description: A front-view form check showing a correct standing posture.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft and hips level.
Stack your shoulders over your hips.
Look straight ahead.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

3737.description: A seated overhead press with one kettlebell, which removes leg drive and keeps the work on the shoulder.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a kettlebell held at your shoulder.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3865.description: A running-style crunch where opposite elbow and knee drive together to work the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and bring one knee toward the opposite elbow.
Extend the other leg out low above the floor.
Switch sides in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set.

3929.description: Lift one leg out to the side while standing. It works the outer hip and helps with balance.
instructions: Stand tall, hands on your hips or on a support.
Keep your toes pointing forward and lift one leg out to the side.
Raise it as high as you can without leaning your torso.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.

3993.description: A push up on dumbbells followed by a front raise. It trains the chest, arms and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank gripping two dumbbells.
Do a push up.
Lift one dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate arms.

4057.description: The first part of a Turkish get up, rising from the floor to a seated position on your hand while holding a kettlebell overhead.
instructions: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same-side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell.
Roll up onto your opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Hold the seated position with your arm vertical.
Reverse the steps to lie back down, then switch sides.

4121.description: A hard push up with one hand on a medicine ball, challenging balance and chest strength.
instructions: Place one hand on the ball and the other on the floor in a plank.
Spread your feet for balance.
Lower your chest toward the ball.
Press back up.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

4185.description: A step up combined with an overhead press. It trains legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold weight at your shoulders and stand facing a bench.
Step up with one foot.
As you stand, press the weight overhead.
Lower the weight as you step down.
Alternate legs.
Keep your core braced.

4249.description: A Russian twist with your legs straight and a dumbbell in hand. The longer lever makes it a tough oblique exercise.
instructions: Sit with your legs straight out and heels just off the floor.
Lean back slightly with a flat back.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other.
Keep your legs steady.
Move smoothly and breathe.

4377.description: An explosive lift that takes a dumbbell from the hang to your shoulder and then overhead. It builds power through the hips, legs and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips, then drive them forward and shrug as you pull the dumbbell up.
Drop under it and catch it at your shoulder with a slight knee bend.
Dip a little, then drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the hang under control.

4441.description: Walking lunges with kettlebells held in the front rack position. Builds leg strength while the core works to keep you upright.
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the front rack, elbows tucked and close to your ribs.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Keep your torso upright and the bells steady against your chest.
Continue alternating legs for the planned distance.

4569.description: A single-arm row using a resistance band, working the lats and mid-back.
instructions: Stand on the band with a staggered stance and hinge forward.
Hold the handle in one hand with your arm extended.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

4633.description: A multi-part warm-up combining a lunge, a rotation and a hamstring stretch.
instructions: Step into a long lunge with both hands on the floor inside your front foot.
Drop your hips low.
Rotate your chest toward the front leg and raise that arm.
Return the hand to the floor and straighten the front leg.
Switch sides and repeat.

4697.description: Swinging the arms down against a band like a skier. It works the shoulders, lats and core.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and hold the ends with both hands.
Stand with a slight bend in your knees.
Pull your arms down and back past your hips.
Squeeze your lats and keep your core braced.
Return slowly overhead and repeat.

4761.description: A one-leg calf raise on a step with a full stretch at the bottom. It builds calf strength and balance.
instructions: Stand on one foot with the ball of that foot on a step, other foot lifted.
Hold a wall or rail for balance.
Lower your heel below the step.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4825.description: A face-down stretch with arms reaching out, opening the chest and front of the shoulders.
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended out wide.
Gently lift your chest off the floor.
Draw your shoulder blades together and back.
Keep your neck in a neutral position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

4889.description: An explosive pull that takes a pair of dumbbells from the floor to your shoulders. It builds power through the hips.
instructions: Stand over the dumbbells with feet hip width and grab them with a flat back.
Push through the floor and extend your hips and knees fast.
Shrug and pull the dumbbells up close to your body.
Drop under them and catch them on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower with control to the floor.
Keep your back flat and the weights close throughout.

5017.description: Squat with a hold in the bottom position. It builds strength out of the hole and control.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and squat down to depth.
Pause in the bottom for about two seconds, staying tight.
Drive up through your whole foot.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

5081.description: Sit upright and slowly tip your head back to look up. It stretches the front of the neck.
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tip your head back to look up at the ceiling.
Keep your mouth closed and move only as far as feels comfortable.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return your head to neutral slowly.

5145.description: Press the back of your head into your hands without moving. It strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your hands clasped behind your head.
Keep your chin level.
Press your head back into your hands without letting it move.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and repeat a few times.

5337.description: A conditioning chain of a burpee, a push-up and mountain climbers. Raises your heart rate quickly.
instructions: Stand tall, then drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back.
Do one push-up.
Run your knees in and out for several mountain climbers.
Jump your feet in toward your hands.
Jump up with arms overhead.
Keep a steady pace and a tight core.

5401.description: Stretches the front of your shoulders and chest using a stick for leverage. Helps with posture and overhead reach.
instructions: Stand tall and hold the stick behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and lift the stick slightly away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

5529.description: Full-depth squat followed by an overhead press, a thruster-style move that works legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold the weight at your shoulders and stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down deeply with chest up.
Drive up through your legs.
Use that momentum to press the weight overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulders and repeat.

5657.description: Side bend using a cable for the obliques.
instructions: Stand side-on to a low cable holding the handle.
Keep your hips still.
Bend sideways away from the cable.
Return to upright.
Switch sides.

5913.description: A lunge with a back bend and one arm reaching up. Stretches the side body and strengthens the legs.
instructions: Step into a wide warrior II stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Reach your front arm up and lean back.
Rest your back hand on your leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then switch.

5977.description: Walking along an imaginary or taped line to train balance and foot control.
instructions: Place a line of tape on the floor or imagine one.
Stand at one end with your arms out for balance.
Walk heel to toe along the line.
Keep your gaze ahead and your core braced.
Turn at the end and walk back.

6041.description: A hip hinge holding a weighted bottle in each hand. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with light load.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bottles along your legs with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your shoulders back and your core braced.

6297.description: A deep backbend pressing up from the floor. It opens the chest and shoulders and strengthens the back and legs.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands beside your head with fingers toward your feet.
Press into hands and feet and lift your hips.
Straighten your arms as you lift the crown of your head off the floor.
Press your chest toward the wall behind.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower slowly.

6361.description: Reverse wrist curls with an EZ bar, an overhand movement that trains the top of your forearms.
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still at your sides.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar upward.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6425.description: Holding a kettlebell at your chest, you hinge at the hips to train hamstrings, glutes and your lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and tip your torso forward, back flat.
Lower until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return upright.

6553.description: A one-leg hip hinge holding a landmine bar. It builds hamstring and glute strength along with balance.
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest and stand on one leg.
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip and send the free leg back for balance.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute and return to standing.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

6745.description: A seated ankle move turning the foot outward against a cable. It strengthens the outer ankle and lower leg.
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot inward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.

6809.description: A sit-up holding a dumbbell overhead with the legs resting on a bench. The extra reach makes the abs work harder.
instructions: Lie on the floor with calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest or overhead.
Curl up into a sit-up, keeping your arms extended.
Reach toward your knees at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

7129.description: A floor hamstring curl using your own weight, alternating legs to keep it easy on the joints.
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Bend one knee and bring the heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top.
Lower the leg slowly.
Repeat with the other leg.
Alternate for the planned reps.

7385.description: Slow lowering phase of a pull-up that builds strength for full pull-ups.
instructions: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower yourself slowly over 3-5 seconds.
Stop at a full hang with straight arms.
Step back up and repeat.

7449.description: Combined raise that hits the front and side delts in one rep.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms to the front up to shoulder height.
Lower them back down.
Raise them out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower with control and repeat.

7577.description: Squat with heels raised to emphasize the quads.
instructions: Stand with your heels on a small plate.
Extend your arms in front.
Squat deep with your chest up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Stand back up.

8025.description: A rotational chop holding a kettlebell from high to low across the body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands and stand with your feet wide.
Start with it high beside one shoulder.
Rotate and chop down to the opposite knee.
Pivot your back foot as you turn.
Return with control and switch sides.

9049.description: Lying on an incline bench, you lift your hips off the pad by curling the pelvis. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and hold the top edge behind your head.
Bring your legs up so your knees are over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up to lift your hips off the bench.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

10329.description: A heavy, high rep one-arm row with a little body momentum, great for lat and grip strength.
instructions: Stand beside a bench with one hand and knee supported on it and hold a heavy dumbbell.
Let the weight hang with a stretch in the lat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip using controlled momentum.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back flat. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

10905.description: A hamstring bridge with an added leg extension. It adds a balance challenge for hips and thighs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Straighten one leg out in front, keeping hips level.
Bring the foot back to the floor without dropping your hips.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

11289.description: A standing drill that loosens the ankles and hips. It is a good warm-up for squats and lunges.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Rotate your ankle and hip through a smooth circle.
Keep your upper body steady.
Do 8-10 slow reps, then switch sides.

11801.description: A lying quad mobilization that gently bends the knee to loosen the front of the thigh.
instructions: Lie on your side or stomach with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle if needed.
Move the knee in and out of the bend in a slow, controlled rhythm.
Keep your hips level and stay within a comfortable range.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, then switch legs.

0025.description: The classic flat bench press. Lower the bar to your chest and press it up to build the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
将杠铃慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
伸展双臂，将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0089.description: A seated close-grip curl with the arms braced on the thighs. Isolates the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your upper arms against your inner thighs, just above your knees, and let the barbell hang down in front of you.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地板上，反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将你的上臂靠在大腿内侧，就在膝盖上方，让杠铃垂在你面前。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上卷曲至肩膀，收缩二头肌。
保持收缩位置短暂停顿，然后吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0153.description: A cable pulldown with arms crossing over. Trains the lats.
instructions: Attach a cable handle to each side of a cable machine at shoulder height.
Stand in the middle of the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and step back to create tension in the cables.
Lean forward slightly from the hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Pull the handles down and across your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆手柄连接到电缆机器两侧与肩同高的位置。
站在机器中间，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄并后退以在电缆中产生张力。
从臀部开始稍微向前倾，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将手柄向下拉并穿过身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0281.description: A sit-up on a decline bench with your arms held straight out in front. It trains the abs through a longer range, and straight arms make it a bit harder.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hook your feet under the pads.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, parallel to the floor.
Curl your torso up, rolling off the bench one section at a time.
Reach your arms toward your knees as you sit up.
Lower back down slowly with control.
Keep your chin off your chest and don't yank with your arms.

0345.description: A face-down one-arm rear lateral raise on a bench. It works the rear delts and the upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, hanging towards the floor.
Keep your arm straight and lift the dumbbell out to the side, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，垂向地板。
保持手臂伸直，将哑铃举到一侧，远离身体。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0409.description: Standing on one leg with a dumbbell, you rise onto your toes and lower slowly. It works the calf and balance.
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step or platform with your heels hanging off and your toes on the step.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your other hand on a wall or railing for support.
Raise your heel as high as possible, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down below the step.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
instructionsZh: 站在台阶或平台的边缘，脚后跟悬垂，脚趾放在台阶上。
一手握住哑铃，另一只手放在墙壁或栏杆上以获得支撑。
尽可能高地抬高脚跟，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回到台阶下方。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一条腿。

0473.description: Hanging from a bar, you fold your legs up toward the bar in a pike. It works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up towards the bar, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your body forms a 'V' shape, with your legs parallel to the ground.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心肌群，将双腿向杠铃方向抬起，保持伸直。
继续抬起身体，直到身体形成“V”形，双腿与地面平行。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0537.description: You clean a kettlebell to your shoulder, then dip and drive it overhead with one arm. A full body power move for legs, shoulders and core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, lowering the kettlebell between your legs.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, using the momentum to swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height.
As the kettlebell reaches shoulder height, rotate your wrist and punch your hand straight up, locking out your arm overhead.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住壶铃，正手握住。
稍微弯曲膝盖并以臀部为铰链，将壶铃放在两腿之间。
爆发性地伸展你的臀部、膝盖和脚踝，利用动量将壶铃摆动到肩膀的高度。
当壶铃到达肩膀高度时，旋转手腕并向上挥拳，将手臂锁定在头顶上方。
将壶铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0601.description: Chest against the pad, you pull the handles back and out with a parallel grip. Targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with a parallel grip, palms facing each other, and keep your arms slightly bent.
Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
平行握住手柄，手掌相对，并保持手臂稍微弯曲。
呼气并将肩胛骨挤压在一起，同时向后和向外拉动手柄，使其远离身体。
在收缩峰值时停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0665.description: A push-up variation with the hands placed in a W shape. It focuses on the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Get into a plank and place your hands in a W position.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your elbows angled slightly out.
Press back up.
Repeat without letting your hips sag.

0793.description: A lateral raise using a band underfoot. It builds the side delts for broader-looking shoulders.
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold an end in each hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band tension.
Avoid shrugging or swinging your body.

0857.description: An ab wheel rollout from the knees, rolling forward and back with control. It builds a strong core and abs.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place the wheel roller in front of you.
Place your hands on the handles of the wheel roller and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Engage your core muscles and slowly roll the wheel forward, keeping your back straight and your abs tight.
Continue rolling forward until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the wheel back towards your knees, maintaining control and keeping your abs engaged.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 跪在地板上，将滚轮放在您面前。
将双手放在滚轮的手柄上，并将手臂伸直至前方。
调动你的核心肌肉，慢慢向前滚动轮子，保持背部挺直，腹肌紧张。
继续向前滚动，直到身体完全伸展并且手臂举过头顶。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将轮子向膝盖方向滚动，保持控制并保持腹肌接合。
重复所需的重复次数。

0921.description: An external rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your body.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

0985.description: A kneeling crunch with a twist using a band. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Kneel down facing away from the anchor point and hold the band with both hands, keeping your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to one side, bringing your hands towards your opposite hip.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
面向远离锚点的方向跪下，用双手握住弹力带，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体两侧。
收紧腹肌，慢慢地将躯干扭向一侧，将双手移向另一侧的臀部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
